capabilities: Search vault Markdown files for chemical substructures drawn in Ketcher
Manage container inventory as tagged Markdown files with structured metadata
Fetch safety data and PubChem CIDs to generate LCSS links
Compute molecular weight, exact mass and elemental analysis offline
Generate ACS-style experimental sections and electrolysis calculations
disambiguation: Not only a search tool; it also manages a reagent inventory and runs offline chemistry calculators.
extras: Installation is manual only (no community store link in the README). Without a drawing plugin installed, substructure search falls back to manual SMILES input.
problem: Obsidian has no way to search notes by chemical structure or to track physical chemical containers and their safety data.

relations.evidence: you must install one of the compatible chemical drawing plugins
you can build powerful dashboards using the Dataview plugin
OpenChemLib for offline molecular parsing and substructure search algorithms
PubChem PUG REST and NIH CACTUS for web chemical identifier resolution

summary: Chemistry plugin that runs vault-wide substructure searches on SMILES strings, manages a container inventory as Markdown files, and computes offline chemoinformatics values.
